title: Bump In The Night
author: Tori Smith
description:
Bump In The Night: An Interactive Fiction Game by Tori Smith

A young child awoken in the night by a shadowy presence at the end of your bed: Monty the Monster. Friend or foe? Perhaps he is just as scared as you. Speaking to Monty can give you information needed to help or hinder your goals. Try not to wake up your dad as you help each other overcome your fears.

Content Warnings: There is some subject matter that may be sensitive to some players. Content includes, but may not be limited to: verbal abuse by a father, mild terror as experienced by a child, death of a loved one, and divorce.

Cover Image by Tori Smith, referenced from original piece by Qube-Core
